## USB Drive Inventory Collector 4.2.8

Fixed automatic drive reads. The app was passing `-jo` to smartctl, which smartctl treated as an invalid option before it could query the drive. The probe now requests JSON with `--json=o`, keeping the original text used for PATA identification. A command option error now stops the probe and appears in the error message instead of being reported as an unreadable drive.

The footer places the record count, workbook path, Copy Path, and Open Folder controls on one centered line. Reset View appears as soon as you change the Recorded Drives layout and hides after restoring the defaults.
